decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already changes the applicable context from SENSOR_BOARD to INTEGRATED_BOARD without altering the still-valid logic-level policy.
The existing same-message MODIFY already converts the board role and supply wording to the integrated board and removes the obsolete interboard input connectors and connector count.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records removal of the modular interboard interface and deletes all interboard topology, connector, and pin-order attributes that remained current.
The existing same-message MODIFY already relocates the pull-ups to the integrated board, removes the obsolete interboard cable-length constraint, and updates scope.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the client's direct approval that connectors may be placed across the proposed board sides as needed.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete separate-main-board activation condition and changes the applicable context to the integrated board.

The existing same-message MODIFY already records that no separate sensor-board package is required, removes its obsolete file-list and board keys, and updates the handoff scope to the integrated board.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete sourceability strategy for interboard connectors; the remaining general and integrated-board sourcing policies remain valid.
The existing same-message MODIFY already updates the 3.3V monitoring coverage and scope for sensors and LEDs located on the integrated board.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the three-board enclosure inventory with one integrated board and updates the corresponding base-mounted hardware.
This Requirement was already scoped to the integrated board before the source Event, and connector placement does not change its battery, USB, or AXP2101 power-path behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY already changes the circuit context from the modular main board to the integrated board while leaving its BOOT and reset behavior unchanged.
